limitations: No quantitative dimension-versus-threshold bound is obtained. The construction uses complex Butson-Hadamard matrices and does not establish an analogous real ±1 Hadamard result. It does not strengthen the infinite Kolmogorov counterexample. The source preprint is very recent, so an unindexed parallel finite-cyclic observation remains possible.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: Garsia counterexamples among finite Butson-Hadamard bases
